---
name: Measurement dispute
about: Miorail stated something it could not have measured
labels: measurement
---

Miorail's whole claim is that it never reports more than it measured. A case
where it did is the most valuable kind of issue here, so this template exists
to make one easy to file.

## What Miorail claimed

Quote it. Include the surface and the `checkedAt` if shown.

## Why that could not have been measured

For example: the provider was down, the window had no data, the token has no
venue, the value shown as zero was never read.

## What it should have said instead

`unavailable`, `not measured`, a named failure — say which and why.

## How you know

On-chain data, a provider response, a block number, a competing tool. Anything
that lets someone else reach the same conclusion.
